newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright to issue 265 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright to issue 265 mln shrs.

text.p: China Everbright International Ltd said on Thursday it will issue 265.40 million new shares to its parent China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd for about HK$340 million, after expenses.

The proceeds will be used to reduce the company's bank loans, to finance its securities and broking and money lending business and to fund investments in China and Hong Kong, China Everbright International said in a statement.
It also said China Everbright Holdings had agreed to place the same amount of shares it held in the company to private investors at HK$1.33 per shares.
On completion of the deals, China Everbright Holdings' stake in the company will be lowered to 62.5 percent from 75 percent, China Everbright International said.
The company's shares closed at HK$1.44 per share on Wednesday.

China Everbright International also said it was in an advanced negotiations on buying a controlling stake in Shenzhen Everbright Timber Industry Co Ltd from China Everbright Holdings, but that no binding agreement had been concluded.
